adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, `attendeesListPromises` maps over `bookingAttendees.attendees` and does `translate: await getTranslation(attendee.locale ?? "en", "common")` inside the per-attendee async function. If multiple attendees share the same locale (common case), this will re-fetch/recompute the same translation bundle multiple times instead of caching per distinct locale. This is a real, diff-grounded performance/efficiency issue but not a functional defect.
